mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_document WHERE source_version_id IN (SELECT sv.id FROM t_source_version sv JOIN t_source s ON s.id=sv.source_id WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) AND status='FAILED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_index_outbox WHERE (knowledge_base_id=#{kb} OR #{kb} IS NULL) AND status='DEAD'

SELECT rule_code ruleCode,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,name, metric,severity,threshold,window_minutes windowMinutes,enabled,channels,created_by createdBy, created_time createdTime,updated_time updatedTime FROM t_alert_rule WHERE rule_code=#{ruleCode}

SELECT rule_code ruleCode,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,name, metric,severity,threshold,window_minutes windowMinutes,enabled,channels,created_by createdBy, updated_time updatedTime FROM t_alert_rule WHERE knowledge_base_id IS NULL OR knowledge_base_id=#{kb} ORDER BY knowledge_base_id IS NULL DESC,id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_alert_event(alert_code,rule_code,knowledge_base_id,severity,status, title,detail_json,metric_value,dedup_key,first_seen,last_seen) VALUES(#{alertCode},#{ruleCode},#{kb},#{severity},'OPEN',#{title},CAST(#{detailJson} AS JSON),#{metricValue}, #{dedupKey},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE occur_count=occur_count+1,last_seen=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,metric_value=VALUES(metric_value), severity=VALUES(severity),title=VALUES(title),detail_json=VALUES(detail_json), status=IF(status='RESOLVED','OPEN',status)
mapper.select: SELECT alert_code alertCode,rule_code ruleCode, knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,severity,status,title,detail_json detailJson,metric_value metricValue, dedup_key dedupKey,occur_count occurCount,first_seen firstSeen,last_seen lastSeen,acked_by ackedBy, acked_time ackedTime,resolved_by resolvedBy,resolved_time resolvedTime,resolve_note resolveNote, created_time createdTime FROM t_alert_event WHERE alert_code=#{alertCode}
SELECT alert_code alertCode,status FROM t_alert_event WHERE dedup_key=#{dedupKey}

SELECT alert_code alertCode,rule_code ruleCode, knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,severity,status,title,detail_json detailJson,metric_value metricValue, dedup_key dedupKey,occur_count occurCount,first_seen firstSeen,last_seen lastSeen,acked_by ackedBy, created_time createdTime FROM t_alert_event
ORDER BY FIELD(status,'OPEN','ACKED','RESOLVED'),last_seen DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_alert_event SET status=#{status}, acked_by=IF(#{status}='ACKED',#{operator},acked_by),acked_time=IF(#{status}='ACKED',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,acked_time), resolved_by=IF(#{status}='RESOLVED',#{operator},resolved_by), resolved_time=IF(#{status}='RESOLVED',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,resolved_time), resolve_note=IF(#{status}='RESOLVED',#{note},resolve_note) WHERE alert_code=#{alertCode}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_alert_event WHERE (knowledge_base_id=#{kb} OR knowledge_base_id IS NULL OR #{kb} IS NULL) AND status IN ('OPEN','ACKED')
